answer: Require every seat to post a fresh verifiable delay function proof each epoch, seeded by that epoch's randomness. A VDF takes about an hour of strictly sequential squaring that no GPU can split up, yet anyone verifies it in milliseconds. An honest agent grading orchard pest surveys gives one kernel thread to it; an operator with three hundred clones must keep three hundred cores busy every epoch, like paying a jetty mooring fee for each boat in a fleet that never sails.
